about: Soil productivity by county from the USDA soil survey (scripts/soil_county.py). n: NCCPI 3.0 overall, acre-weighted across the county's rated farmland; p: percent of the county's mapped acres that is prime farmland; q: percent that is prime farmland only if drained or otherwise improved; fa: farmland acres; s0, s1: oldest and newest survey date of the survey areas the county lies in. states: each state's read (ok, or kept from the read of 'since', with the reason).
farmland: prime farmland, prime farmland if drained or otherwise improved (irrigated, protected from flooding), and farmland of statewide, local or unique importance (SSURGO farmland classification)
rule: NCCPI - National Commodity Crop Productivity Index (Ver 3.0)
source: USDA NRCS SSURGO, Soil Data Access
